import odoolib, json
c=odoolib.get_connection(hostname='127.0.0.1',protocol='json2',port=8069,database='bench',password=open('/etc/odoo/api_key').read().strip())
MO=c.get_model('mrp.production'); WO=c.get_model('mrp.workorder'); PO=c.get_model('purchase.order'); POL=c.get_model('purchase.order.line')
# Cancel precisely the three confirmed orders scheduled on the unavailable line.
affected=[2,4,5]
MO.action_cancel(ids=affected)
# Re-create only the feasible 76-unit portion on Fabrication Cell 2: 3,420 minutes; 1,710 retained + 3,420 = 5,130 <= 5,555.
plans=[
 {'product_id':2,'product_qty':37.0,'origin':'S00003, S00004, S00005','date_start':'2026-10-10 08:00:00','date_finished':'2026-10-17 17:00:00'},
 {'product_id':2,'product_qty':37.0,'origin':'S00006, S00007','date_start':'2026-10-11 08:00:00','date_finished':'2026-10-18 17:00:00'},
 {'product_id':2,'product_qty':2.0,'origin':'S00010','date_start':'2026-10-12 08:00:00','date_finished':'2026-10-19 17:00:00'}]
new_ids=MO.create(vals_list=plans)
MO.action_confirm(ids=new_ids)
# Set required dates and assign every replacement work order to Fabrication Cell 2, never Assembly Line 1.
new_mos=MO.read(ids=new_ids,fields=['id','name','date_start','date_finished','workorder_ids','origin','state'])
for m in new_mos:
    if m['workorder_ids']:
        WO.write(ids=m['workorder_ids'],vals={'workcenter_id':2,'date_start':m['date_start'],'date_finished':m['date_finished']})
# Extend the already-confirmed Pivot PO (one consolidated PO for its offer) to its 30-unit vendor limit.
PO.write(ids=[20],vals={'origin':'S00003, S00010'})
p20line=POL.search(domain=[('order_id','=',20),('product_id','=',2)])
POL.write(ids=p20line,vals={'product_qty':30.0,'date_planned':'2026-10-13 17:00:00'})
# Create the sole Baltic one-unit PO, with the affected SO in Source and a date within its five-day offer lead.
p22=PO.create(vals_list=[{'partner_id':9,'origin':'S00003','date_order':'2026-10-08 08:00:00'}])[0]
POL.create(vals_list=[{'order_id':p22,'product_id':2,'product_qty':1.0,'price_unit':3903.5,'date_planned':'2026-10-13 17:00:00'}])
PO.button_confirm(ids=[p22])
# Preserve component commitments but replace canceled MO references with their actual replacement-MO references.
newnames={r['origin']:r['name'] for r in MO.read(ids=new_ids,fields=['name','origin'])}
repl={'WH/MO/00002':newnames['S00003, S00004, S00005'],'WH/MO/00004':newnames['S00006, S00007'],'WH/MO/00005':newnames['S00010']}
pos=PO.search_read(domain=[('id','<=',18)],fields=['id','origin'],limit=100)
for p in pos:
    old=p['origin'] or ''
    parts=[x.strip() for x in old.split(',') if x.strip()]
    changed=[repl.get(x,x) for x in parts]
    # de-duplicate while retaining source order
    out=[]
    for x in changed:
        if x not in out: out.append(x)
    new=', '.join(out)
    if new != old: PO.write(ids=[p['id']],vals={'origin':new})
print(json.dumps({'cancelled':MO.read(ids=affected,fields=['name','state','origin']),'new_mos':MO.read(ids=new_ids,fields=['name','product_qty','state','origin','date_start','date_finished','workorder_ids']),'new_workorders':WO.search_read(domain=[('production_id','in',new_ids)],fields=['production_id','workcenter_id','duration_expected','date_start','date_finished','state'],limit=20),'p20':PO.read(ids=[20],fields=['name','state','origin','date_planned','order_line']),'p20_lines':POL.read(ids=p20line,fields=['product_qty','price_unit','date_planned']),'p22':PO.read(ids=[p22],fields=['name','state','origin','date_planned','order_line'])},default=str))
